utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: A quiet call later today works, and if you can bring labels, boxes, and a marker this afternoon, I can sort things out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — I can bring labels, boxes, and a marker this afternoon. What time should I call later today?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: After 6 would be best for me, if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring the Phillips screwdriver set and any spare zip ties I have. See you at the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — that’ll be a big help. See you at the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Glad to help — see you at the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No rush, Dane — send me the list when you’re ready, and I’ll keep track of what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’m putting it together now and I’ll send the list over shortly.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Dane — I’ll be here and keep track of the remaining supplies.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, we’re still on for 3 PM today?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, still on for 3 PM today. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming — see you at 3 PM.

utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Tess—I’ll see you Sunday at the community center with the screwdriver set and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Sam—thanks again! See you Sunday at the community center for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You got it, Tess—see you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Sam — sorting the tools and checking what needs replacing first is a great start. I’ll keep everything organized and meet you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Rosa — I’ll bring the screwdriver set and gloves on Sunday at the community center and get the tools sorted first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Sam — I appreciate it. I’ll be there Sunday at the community center, and we’ll get everything running smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Faye. I’ll be there Saturday at 9 and we can keep things simple.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, Saturday at 9 works for me too—I’ll come by after school pickup and help get things set up.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works fine, Faye. I’ll see you Saturday at 9 and we’ll keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — I’ll wait for your update, and then I can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — I’ll wait for your update, and then I can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah — the donated items are the priority, and if you spot anything missing, let me know so we can fill the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll sort the donated items and keep an eye out for anything missing, especially screwdrivers, zip ties, and small wrenches.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — thanks for watching for those. If you find any other gaps, just flag them and I’ll help track them down.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, that sounds like the right route for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yep — the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center, so that’s the spot to send folks now.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks for the update — I’ll keep sending people to the community center for Sunday now. That should keep the repair drive on track.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ll check my notes for the spare wood and labels and send over anything missing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect — I’ll keep the supplies list updated, and just let me know what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do — I’ll check my notes and send anything missing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I’m still in. If there’s a checklist going, just point me at the next thing to sort out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Oren — could you handle the boxes by the table and keep an eye on the checklist? I’m just making sure everything stays organized.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: You got it, Pia — I’ll handle the boxes by the table and keep an eye on the checklist. Just point me at the next thing if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Eli — I’m checking the missing items now and I’ll send them over shortly.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Dane. I’ll keep things lined up here and wait for your update on the missing items.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’m on the missing items now and should have them to you shortly.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do, Jules — I’ll swing back by after errands and report what I find.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Ira — appreciate you keeping tabs. Let me know what they still need when you swing back by.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely, Jules — I’ll check in after errands and let you know what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll bring the tools. See you at 9 on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect, thanks Mina—9 works great. See you Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good—see you Saturday at 9.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — I’ll ask a few neighbors to help and remind them to bring their tools. I’ll keep passing the updates along too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an ear out for your updates and let folks know the repair drive’s moving along.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll keep asking around and pass along anything new I hear about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — please keep the pickup time and Saturday morning details front and center so folks don’t get mixed up. If you can, remind everyone to bring tools too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep the pickup time and Saturday morning details front and center, and I’ll remind everyone to bring tools too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — that should help a lot. Just keep the details clear so nobody shows up at the wrong time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep — I’ll check who’s available first and then send the update. And yes, we’re still on for 3 PM today.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just making sure — 3 PM today is still the plan, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, 3 PM is still the plan. I’ll check who’s available now and send you a quick update.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — I’m still only catching scraps myself. Let me know if you hear anything concrete.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Still just scraps on my end too — they’re figuring out what needs fixing and who can help. If I hear something concrete, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — I’ll keep an ear out too and let you know if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — it’s now Sunday at the community center, and I’ll keep it low-key.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I really appreciate you keeping it low-key.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll keep you posted if anything else changes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, Rosa — I’ll be there Sunday at the community center and help with both.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Rey — that’s a huge help. I’ll send the supply list and house-check route so you can jump right in on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, thanks, Rosa — I’ll look for the list and route, and I’ll be ready on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks, Gus — I’ll head over right after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect — I’ll have the tools ready for you.

utterances.speaker: Faye

utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll set the sign-up at the community center parking lot and check the tools list for tool kits and spare batteries.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, the community center parking lot works. I’ll note that and watch for any missing tools or batteries.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Okay, I’ll keep an eye out for anything missing and make sure the tool kits and spare batteries stay on the list.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, Hana — once you have the list and timing, send it over and I’ll bring whatever tools fit best.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — I’ll confirm the repair list and timing, then send it over so you can bring the right tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Hana — just send the list and timing when you’ve got them, and I’ll make sure I bring the right tools.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll spread the word that it’s Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — I appreciate it. I’ll send you the updated details right after this.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll get the word out right away.
